obligations.expected_behavior: Each retained evaluation seed uses only `anchor_candidate`, `challenge_candidate`, or `non_baseline_exploratory_candidate` as its classification.
forbidden_result: A retained evaluation seed uses any classification outside the closed approved non-baseline set.
A retained evaluation seed becomes a baseline or evaluation-set member within TC-D1.
obligations.observable_result: Each retained seed record has exactly one allowed classification and no prohibited baseline or evaluation-set classification.
obligations.state_after: All retained seed classifications conform to the closed non-baseline set.
obligations.state_before: Retained seed classifications have not been verified against the closed allowed set.
obligations.subject: Evaluation-seed classification
obligations.trigger: A retained evaluation seed is recorded or evaluated.

obligations.expected_behavior: During re-enable, every applicable real Consumer invokes the current approved Candidate Route and captures its current result.
forbidden_result: Re-enable omits the Candidate Route call.
Re-enable uses an unapproved or stale Candidate Route.
Re-enable lacks capture of the Candidate Route's current result.
obligations.observable_result: Per-Consumer re-enable receipts show a real invocation of the current approved Candidate Route and its captured current result.
obligations.state_after: Every applicable Consumer has completed re-enable through the current approved Candidate Route with a captured result.
obligations.state_before: The Candidate Route remains approved and current, but re-enable execution has not been demonstrated.
obligations.subject: Re-enable transition
obligations.trigger: A re-enable transition is executed for an applicable Consumer.

obligations.expected_behavior: Current Skill-input v2 behavior remains retained, and redesign of Skill-input v1/current-pointer semantics is rejected.
forbidden_result: A v1/current-pointer semantic redesign is accepted as TC-D1 work.
Current Skill-input v2 behavior is replaced by a legacy semantic redesign.
obligations.observable_result: Scope validation rejects proposals that redesign Skill-input v1/current-pointer semantics while retaining current Skill-input v2 behavior.
obligations.state_after: TC-D1 scope preserves current Skill-input v2 behavior without redesigning legacy v1/current-pointer semantics.
obligations.state_before: A proposed change may attempt to redesign legacy Skill-input semantics.
obligations.subject: Skill-input semantic boundary
obligations.trigger: TC-D1 scope or implementation changes are evaluated.

obligations.expected_behavior: Historical and failed-Candidate evidence is preserved, and new Consumer and rollback evidence is append-only and isolated.
forbidden_result: Failed-Candidate evidence is removed, rewritten, or overwritten.
New Consumer or rollback evidence overwrites existing evidence.
obligations.observable_result: Evidence records retain historical and failed-Candidate evidence, while new Consumer and rollback evidence is appended as isolated records.
obligations.state_after: Failed-Candidate evidence remains preserved and new Consumer and rollback evidence is append-only.
obligations.state_before: Existing historical and failed-Candidate evidence exists before new Consumer or rollback evidence is added.
obligations.subject: Failed-Candidate evidence
obligations.trigger: New Consumer or rollback evidence is produced.

obligations.expected_behavior: Unaffected Matrix Cases demonstrate preserved behavior.
forbidden_result: An unaffected Matrix Case is treated as successful without demonstrating preserved behavior.
A regression in an unaffected Matrix Case is accepted.
obligations.observable_result: Evidence for each unaffected Matrix Case demonstrates its preserved behavior under the Matrix Contract.
obligations.state_after: Unaffected Matrix Cases have demonstrated preserved behavior.
obligations.state_before: Unaffected Matrix Cases have not yet demonstrated preserved behavior.
obligations.subject: Unaffected Matrix Cases

obligations.expected_behavior: A success path cannot make a required Consumer route check unreachable.
forbidden_result: A required Consumer route check is unreachable on a success path.
A successful result is accepted when a required Consumer route check was bypassed.
obligations.observable_result: Success-path evaluation confirms that every required Consumer route check remains reachable and executed.
obligations.state_after: All required Consumer route checks remain reachable on success paths.
obligations.state_before: Required Consumer route-check reachability on success paths has not been established.
obligations.subject: Required Consumer route checks
obligations.trigger: A Consumer success path is evaluated.

obligations.expected_behavior: Creation of another TC-D1 requirement tree is rejected.
forbidden_result: An alternate or replacement TC-D1 requirement tree is created or accepted.
obligations.observable_result: Scope validation rejects creation of another TC-D1 requirement tree.
obligations.state_after: TC-D1 work uses the canonical requirement tree without creating another one.
obligations.state_before: A proposed change may attempt to create another TC-D1 requirement tree.
obligations.subject: TC-D1 requirement-tree boundary
obligations.trigger: TC-D1 scope or artifact creation is evaluated.

obligations.expected_behavior: Before evaluation, a candidate-external trust envelope produced through the existing authority path freezes validator content, complete Semantic Dependency identities, support policy, and scope; any missing, ambiguous, or changed member invalidates the envelope.
forbidden_result: A Candidate change set produces or controls the trust envelope.
Evaluation proceeds without a pre-evaluation frozen trust envelope.
A missing, ambiguous, or changed envelope member remains valid.
obligations.observable_result: A pre-evaluation trust envelope bound outside the Candidate change set records validator content, the complete Semantic Dependency identities, support policy, and scope; validation rejects an envelope with any missing, ambiguous, or changed member.
obligations.state_after: Evaluation relies only on a current, candidate-external, complete frozen trust envelope.
obligations.state_before: Validator trust-envelope lifecycle and complete frozen binding have not been established.
obligations.subject: Validator trust envelope
obligations.trigger: Validator Capability evaluation is prepared or performed.

obligations.expected_behavior: Every Matrix Case owns a distinct fixture or state transition, a frozen expectation, two subject executions, and separate observations.
forbidden_result: Two Matrix Cases share a fixture or state transition instead of each owning a distinct one.
A Matrix Case lacks a frozen expectation, either subject execution, or separate observations.
obligations.observable_result: Matrix evidence identifies a distinct case-owned fixture or state transition, frozen expectation, Stable and Candidate executions, and separate observations for every Matrix Case.
obligations.state_after: Every Matrix Case has independently owned fixture or state-transition evidence.
obligations.state_before: Matrix Cases may have distinct inputs without established ownership of distinct fixtures or state transitions.
obligations.subject: Matrix Case fixture or state-transition ownership
obligations.trigger: A Matrix Case is defined or evaluated.

obligations.expected_behavior: A Consumer-transition omission is allowed only when an existing authorized repository or ADR owner has confirmed and explicitly bound the exception before execution; until then, no exception exists.
forbidden_result: A Consumer transition is omitted without pre-execution confirmation and an explicit bound exception.
An implementation creates its own Consumer-transition exception.
obligations.observable_result: Any omitted Consumer transition has a pre-execution, explicitly bound exception from an existing authorized repository or ADR owner; otherwise the transition executes.
obligations.state_after: Every Consumer transition executes unless a confirmed and bound authorized exception exists before execution.
obligations.state_before: No Consumer Manifest exception exists until required confirmation and binding are established.
obligations.subject: Consumer Manifest exception authority
obligations.trigger: A Consumer-transition omission or applicability exception is considered.

obligations.expected_behavior: The aggregate is invalidated when an expected output or expectation is forged.
forbidden_result: Forged expected output or expectation is accepted.
The aggregate succeeds despite expectation-forged Matrix evidence.
obligations.observable_result: Detection of forged expected output or expectation produces aggregate invalidation.
obligations.state_after: Expectation-forged Matrix evidence cannot produce aggregate success.
obligations.state_before: Matrix evidence may contain an expected output or expectation whose authenticity has not been established.
obligations.subject: Expectation-forged Matrix evidence
obligations.trigger: Matrix expectations or expected outputs are evaluated.

obligations.expected_behavior: Semantic Dependency closure includes every executable, data artifact, policy, configuration value, and environment representation that can affect target selection, verdict, diagnostic category, or evidence validity; Probe reachability neither defines nor narrows this closure.
forbidden_result: A semantic dependency that can affect target selection, verdict, diagnostic category, or evidence validity is omitted.
Probe reachability defines or narrows Semantic Dependency closure.
obligations.observable_result: The dependency closure records all five required categories for every result-affecting member, and closure validation rejects omissions based on Probe reachability.
obligations.state_after: Semantic Dependency closure is exhaustive across all required categories and is not narrowed by Probe reachability.
obligations.state_before: Dependency closure may not yet include every result-affecting executable, data, policy, configuration, and environment representation.
obligations.subject: Semantic-dependency closure
obligations.trigger: Validator Capability or Current Snapshot dependencies are established or validated.

obligations.expected_behavior: Terminal categories are limited to `pass`, `comparison-failed`, `invalid-input`, `identity-invalid`, `evidence-invalid`, `stale`, `execution-failed`, and `timed-out`, except that a Matrix Case may report `expected-difference` under the Matrix rules; serialized aliases may be versioned but cannot merge a failure into success or silently reinterpret these categories.
forbidden_result: A terminal category outside the declared set is accepted.
A serialized alias merges a failure into success.
A serialized alias silently reinterprets a declared terminal category.
`expected-difference` is reported outside the Matrix rules.
obligations.observable_result: Terminal-result validation accepts only the declared categories and verifies that any versioned alias preserves failure and category semantics.
obligations.state_after: Terminal categories and serialized aliases preserve the declared terminal semantics.
obligations.state_before: Terminal-category and serialized-alias semantic preservation has not been established.
obligations.subject: Terminal result categories
obligations.trigger: A terminal result or serialized alias is produced or validated.
